images.title: A half turn and then a quarter turn more
images.purpose: Show a fan stick turning a half turn (a straight angle) and then a quarter turn more, so that the whole turn is 3/4, more than a straight angle.
images.composition: One large circle diagram in the middle with the fixed stick, the two turns drawn as curved arrows and the sum written on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. DIAGRAM, corner point (500, 420) shown as a dark dot 26 px across. A teal #0072B2 fixed stick (12 px line, 300 px long) goes to the right from the corner along y 420 and carries the label start (34 px, bold, dark) above its end at (800, 380). A pale grey #6B7280 dashed circle of radius 300 px centred on the corner. The turning stick is amber #E69F00 (12 px line, 300 px long). It is drawn in two places: a dashed amber line going straight left from the corner (after the half turn, ending at (200, 420)) with the label half turn (34 px, bold) above its end; and a solid amber line going straight down from the corner (after one quarter turn more, ending at (500, 720)) with the label 1/4 more (34 px, bold) to its right at (540, 700). Two curved arrows with arrowheads on a circle of radius 120 px, both going the same way (up, over the top to the left, and then down): a teal arrow from the start stick over the top to the dashed stick, and an amber arrow from the dashed stick down to the solid stick. A pale amber #E69F00 fill (30 percent opaque) for the sector swept from the start stick to the solid stick (three quarters of the circle). RIGHT SIDE: three lines of dark bold text (56 px) left aligned at x 920: 1/2 + 1/4 at y 300, = 3/4 turn at y 390, and, smaller (38 px) at y 480 and y 530, more than a straight angle in two lines: more than a / straight angle. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any angle written as a number with a small circle sign
more or fewer than 2 curved arrows
images.takeaway: A half turn and a quarter turn more make a 3/4 turn, which is more than a straight angle.
images.description: A fixed stick pointing right, a turning stick shown after a half turn and after a quarter turn more, with the swept three quarters of a circle shaded and 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 turn written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Straight Angle and More Than a Straight Angle. It follows the idea of the half turn and the three-quarter turn circles in your maths book and shows the concept's own example of a half turn and a quarter turn more.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the turning stick with a finger. The slip to watch is thinking that a turn of more than a half has no size, or that a straight line is not an angle.

image_decisions.why: The turning stick after a half turn and after a quarter turn more shows the straight angle and the turn beyond it.
